## Problem and result

Describe the user problem, final behavior, and design rationale. Link the issue if applicable.

## Quality gate evidence

Follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md). Record results actually observed.

- Automated: `npm run check` result.
- Manual: applicable Figma QA results, or why not applicable; list unverified items.
- Visual: same-size before/after screenshots and keyboard/focus checks, if the UI changed.

## Review

- [ ] Diff is focused; docs and relevant regressions are updated.
- [ ] Applicable quality gates have evidence above; generated changes were reviewed.
